findings.issue: With لازلو as the subject of يُلحق this reads 'Lazlo inflicts no Burn damage' — the opposite of an immunity, which is a defensive property. The intended passive reading ('no Burn damage reaches Lazlo') would need an accusative لازلو, and the name is indeclinable, so the sentence cannot disambiguate itself. Every sibling immunity row in the build uses the unambiguous لدى X مناعة (Eredrim/Frost, Gragu/Bloodcurse, Genessa/Stasis).

'قتل غراغو' is an ambiguous iḍāfa: read as an objective genitive it means 'killing Gragu', i.e. the reward is granted for killing the player's own Shell. The English is unambiguous — these are kills BY Gragu. The sibling row GraguSkillHeartless_Effect_1 avoids it correctly with a verb ('يقتلهم غراغو').
findings.suggested_ar: يمنحك كل عدوٍّ يقتله غراغو {X} إضافيًا من <Bold>القَتام</>.

findings.issue: The skill is literally about hearts — its own description (GraguSkillHeartlessDesc) says Staggering Blow 'rips out the victim's heart', and the neighbouring skill Heartwork is kept as عمل القلب. القسوة ('cruelty') keeps only the figurative half and loses the pun the name is built on.

findings.source_en: Only {Y} of <Slaughterer>Slaughterer</> stacks are removed upon being <Bold>severed</>
findings.ar: لا يُزال سوى {Y} من تراكمات <Slaughterer>السفّاح</> عند <Bold>الانفصال</>.
findings.issue: 'Severed' is the series' term for being knocked out of your Shell — it pairs with Shell = الهَيكل and is not a generic 'separation'. الانفصال gives the player no way to know which event this is. The term is not in the glossary and needs an owner ruling.
findings.suggested_ar: لا يُزال سوى {Y} من تراكمات <Slaughterer>السفّاح</> عند <Bold>الانسلاخ عن الهَيكل</>.
